scope: Install a 1/3 HP, 50 GPM cast-iron submersible pump in a wet, muddy crawl space. Hand-dig a hole for a five-gallon bucket basin and connect flexible discharge pipe to the existing French drain outside.
priced_line_descriptions: Cast-iron pump, four bags of gravel, reducer and flexible discharge pipe

scope: Remove the existing split heat pump and replace it with a Goodman 18-SEER split system with staged operation, outdoor unit GSZC180241 and indoor air handler AVPTC25B14. Two installers worked four hours each. Installer agreed to match wholesale component pricing.
priced_line_descriptions: Replacement heat pump equipment and parts

scope: Replace one broken half-bath toilet. The homeowner buys an American Standard VorMax, and a plumber installs it and hauls away the old fixture. Installation took approximately one hour.

Replace worn garage entry and rear entry hardware with two deadbolts and two doorknob locks before selling a house. The front entrance hardware is already new. The locksmith supplies the four replacements and charges separately for the visit and installation.
Install a new Amarr two-car garage door with windows and a LiftMaster half-horsepower opener. Quote the door, window upgrade and opener as installed components. Exact door dimensions are unavailable.

Replace a 50-gallon Rheem water heater with a licensed contractor. Include 8 feet of copper, a gas flex line and shutoff, two braided water connectors, seismic brackets, venting and a drain pan with alarm. Include the city permit.
priced_line_descriptions: Installation hardware including specified fittings, brackets, venting and pan

scope: Respond to a homeowner's urgent call for a garage door with one broken spring. Supply and replace both torsion springs. The customer reports the wire size as .225 in. Door weight, dimensions and cycle rating are unspecified.

Paint two bedrooms, two bathrooms, the kitchen, two hallways and one additional wall. Spray the ceilings. The homeowner paid separately for paint and labor. No separate charge for sundries was reported.
priced_line_descriptions: Labor to paint the listed rooms, walls and ceilings

scope: Finish a walk-in closet using IKEA PAX wardrobes the owners assemble themselves. A contractor trims the modules and adds crown moulding and baseboards for a built-in appearance. Moulding and baseboards are owner-supplied at no charge. Painters caulk seams and nail holes, apply bonding primer and paint white. The owners handle minor detailing and hardware.
priced_line_descriptions: IKEA PAX closet system purchased by owner

scope: Install owner-provided runner sections on 13 stairs in Hollywood style. The narrower upstairs hallway requires a separate loose runner. Take three remaining runner sections to the shop, cut and re-serge the edges, then deliver the finished hall runner. The staircase installation took a few hours. Price only the two contractor services.
priced_line_descriptions: Install the stair runner on 13 steps
Cut, re-serge and deliver the hallway runner

scope: Paint walls, ceilings and trim in the living room, foyer, stairway and hall, including tall open spaces and the foyer tray ceiling. Finish the deck in the same engagement. Homeowner supplies paint, stain, paper, tape and caulk. Exact surface and deck areas were not given.
priced_line_descriptions: Painter's flat charge for the interior work and deck finishing

scope: Patch and repaint seven rooms in a rental house after it was raised several inches. Complete the urgent interior work before oak flooring goes in. Include ceilings except in two bedrooms, and omit door and window casings. Return to finish the baseboards after flooring installation.
priced_line_descriptions: Patch and paint the interior including the specified ceilings
Return visit to finish the baseboards
